title: Adaeze's 30th
pull_quote: I put mine up two weeks before my birthday and sent it to the family group. Two hundred wishes by the end of the week, and enough gifted to finally take the trip I kept postponing.

wishes.name: James Adeyinka
wishes.message: Thirty looks unbothered on you. Wishing you a year with no stress and plenty of jollof.

wishes.name: Abisola Okonkwo
wishes.message: I have known you since you were this small. Look at you now, standing on your own two feet. God bless you my dear.

wishes.name: Tolu Oyelaran
wishes.message: Found the photo from Lagos 2019 — attaching it before you delete it 😂

wishes.name: Chinelo Okonkwo
wishes.message: From the girl who cried through her first day at Unilag to this. I am so proud of you, sis.

wishes.name: Sunday Adeleke
wishes.message: Your late father would be beaming today. Keep making him proud.

title: Chidi & Amaka
pull_quote: Half our guests were abroad and couldn't make the wedding. The page meant they were still part of it — messages, photos, and contributions towards the honeymoon instead of a registry we didn't need.

wishes.name: Emeka Nwosu
wishes.message: Two families became one today. Chidi, treat her well. Amaka, be patient with him — he is my brother's son after all.

wishes.name: Ifeoma Nwachukwu
wishes.message: Watching from Houston at 4am and crying like a baby. The dress, Amaka. THE DRESS.

wishes.name: Kelechi Agu
wishes.message: May your home never lack laughter, and may your generator never fail during harmattan. 😄

wishes.name: Roseline Iheme
wishes.message: We prayed for this day for eleven years. God does not forget.

wishes.name: Obiora Anigbogu
wishes.message: Chidi talked about her every single lunch break for three years. Glad the rest of us finally get some peace.

title: Tunde's graduation
pull_quote: I set it up for my brother's graduation in about thirty seconds on my phone. What got me was the photobook at the end — all of it in one PDF instead of scattered across four group chats.

wishes.name: Bimpe Adeyemi
wishes.message: Five years, one strike after another, and you still finished with a 2:1. My brother, well done.

wishes.name: Folasade Adeyemi
wishes.message: The first graduate in this family. I am carrying my chest high today.

wishes.name: Lekan Oyewole
wishes.message: From the boy who could not do algebra in JSS2. Look at God.

wishes.name: Ibrahim Ajala
wishes.message: Congrats Tundeeee. You still owe us for the noodles. We are keeping records.

wishes.name: Ronke Adeyemi
wishes.message: Sent something small for the new chapter. Do not spend it on shawarma.

title: Baby Obiageli
pull_quote: Group gifting was the whole point for us. Instead of six people buying six different prams, everyone put in towards one good one. It was funded in two days.

wishes.name: Chika Udeh
wishes.message: Ngozi, you are going to be the kind of mother people write songs about. Cannot wait to meet her.

wishes.name: Nkechi Eze
wishes.message: Nwa m, sleep now while you still can. That is the only advice I have that anybody ever uses.

wishes.name: Adaobi Nwaneri
wishes.message: We put in towards the pram. Push it proudly around Wuse Park and think of us.

wishes.name: Amina Lawal
wishes.message: Nine months of scans and worry and here we are. Rest, drink water, be gentle with yourself.

wishes.name: Halima Yakubu
wishes.message: We already voted: Aunty Ngozi's maternity leave is far too short. Come back whenever, the desk is yours.

title: Pa Samuel Okafor
pull_quote: We used it for my father's memorial. It sounds like an odd fit for something called CelebrateMi, but a quiet page where people could leave tributes was exactly what the family needed.

wishes.name: Ifeanyi Okafor
wishes.message: He taught mathematics in Owerri for thirty-one years and never once raised his voice at a child. That is the whole man, in one sentence.

wishes.name: Godwin Anyanwu
wishes.message: Sir, you paid my school fees in 1976 and told me never to mention it. I am mentioning it now.

wishes.name: Chinyere Okafor
wishes.message: Uncle Sam. Sunday afternoons on that veranda were the safest place I knew as a child.

wishes.name: Nkem Okafor
wishes.message: Grandpa, I passed my WAEC. You were the first person I wanted to tell.

wishes.name: Bartholomew Nwodo
wishes.message: A good man has left. Owerri is quieter for it. Rest well, our brother.

title: Blessing at 40
pull_quote: Money landed in the wallet as gifts came in, and the withdrawal hit my bank the next day. That was the part I was most nervous about and it turned out to be the part I thought about least.

wishes.name: Hauwa Bala
wishes.message: Forty and finally opening the shop. We have been hearing about this shop since 2011, Blessing. Congratulations.

wishes.name: Ladi Danjuma
wishes.message: Our sister, you have carried all of us at one time or another. Today we carry you. Happy birthday.

wishes.name: Sunday Terwase
wishes.message: Still the loudest laugh in any room. Never change it.

wishes.name: Grace Adamu
wishes.message: Forty years of God's faithfulness over your life. The next forty will be louder.

wishes.name: Ismail Ibrahim
wishes.message: Mummy, I helped Aunty set this page up. Don't tell her I spent my own pocket money on the gift.

title: Emeka makes partner
pull_quote: Nobody expects a page for a promotion. That is exactly why it landed — my colleagues wrote things they would never have said out loud in the office.

registry.name: The suit he has been eyeing

wishes.name: Wale Ogunbanjo
wishes.message: I hired you as a junior who could not find the courtroom. Today you are my partner. Well earned, Emeka.

wishes.name: Nkiru Obi
wishes.message: Ten years of you leaving the house at 5am. The children and I are so proud of you, my love.

wishes.name: Preye Diri
wishes.message: You are the only partner who actually reads our drafts before the meeting. Congratulations sir.

wishes.name: Chidera Eluwa
wishes.message: Remember NYSC in Bauchi, sleeping on that mat? Look at you now.

wishes.name: Josephine Obi
wishes.message: Your father drove a taxi so you could sit for those exams. He is dancing somewhere tonight.

title: Folake at 50
pull_quote: My children made it without telling me. I woke up on my birthday to three hundred messages from people I had not heard from in twenty years.

wishes.name: Yemi Ajayi
wishes.message: Mummy, you raised three of us on one salary and a sewing machine. Fifty looks like victory on you.

wishes.name: Kemi Alabi
wishes.message: Folake! From Molete to this. Do you remember selling puff-puff after school? Happy golden jubilee my friend.

wishes.name: Sade Bankole
wishes.message: You sewed my wedding dress in four days and refused to take money for it. I have never forgotten.

wishes.name: Taiwo Adegoke
wishes.message: Iya wa, e ku ori ire. May you eat the fruit of your labour in good health.

wishes.name: Damola Ajayi
wishes.message: Twenty-six years married to you and you still make me laugh in the kitchen. Happy birthday, my darling.

title: Yusuf & Halima at 25
pull_quote: Our children live in three different countries. This was the first time in years that all of them said something to us on the same day.

wishes.name: Amina Bello
wishes.message: Baba and Mama, twenty-five years and you still eat from the same plate. That is the standard you set for us.

wishes.name: Danladi Garba
wishes.message: I stood as witness at your nikkah in 2000. Barka da sallah, barka da zaman aure.

wishes.name: Hauwa Bello
wishes.message: Mama, I still call you before every big decision. Twenty-five years of showing us what patience looks like.

wishes.name: Musa Bello
wishes.message: Dad, you have not won a single argument in twenty-five years and you look happier for it. 😂

wishes.name: Nafisa Bello
wishes.message: Grandpa and Grandma, we pooled our pocket money. It is not much but it is all of it.

title: Chiamaka called to bar
pull_quote: Law school nearly finished me. Reading what people wrote on that page on the morning of the call is the only reason I did not cry through the whole ceremony.

wishes.name: Emmanuel Nnadi
wishes.message: Barrister Nnadi. I have been practising saying it for five years. Today I finally get to.

wishes.name: Uche Nnadi
wishes.message: You argued with me about bedtime when you were four. We all saw this coming.

wishes.name: Adanna Nnadi
wishes.message: The first lawyer in the whole family. Nne, you have opened a door that will not close.

wishes.name: Halima Abdullahi
wishes.message: The girl who explained land law to all of us at 2am. We would not have passed without you.

wishes.name: Theresa Nnadi
wishes.message: I sold the last of my land for that first year's fees and I would do it again tomorrow.

title: Mama Grace at 70
pull_quote: She does not use a smartphone. We printed the whole page as a photobook and read it to her on the day. She made us read some of them twice.

wishes.name: Ebele Uche
wishes.message: Mama, you fed six children and half of the street on one trader's income. Seventy years and you are still the strongest person I know.

wishes.name: Ngozi Kalu
wishes.message: Mama Grace, you gave credit to people who could not pay and never once shamed them for it. God bless you.

wishes.name: Onyeka Mbah
wishes.message: Seventy years. Front pew, every Sunday, rain or sun. Heaven has been paying attention.

wishes.name: Chidinma Agu
wishes.message: You took me in when I had nowhere in 1998. I named my daughter after you.

wishes.name: Emeka Uche
wishes.message: Grandma, thank you for teaching me to count using groundnuts in your shop. Still my best maths lesson.

title: Segun retires
pull_quote: Thirty-four years at the same company and I thought I would get a card. Instead two hundred people wrote to me. I have read it about forty times.

wishes.name: Tayo Falana
wishes.message: You trained four generations of engineers at that plant, including me. Go and rest, sir. You have done enough.

wishes.name: Ifedayo Sowole
wishes.message: Thirty-four years without one missed handover. Who is going to open the gate at 6am now?

wishes.name: Yetunde Ogundipe
wishes.message: I have shared you with that company since 1992. From next month you are all mine, and you will be doing the washing up.

wishes.name: Kunle Ogundipe
wishes.message: Dad, you never once complained about the traffic on Third Mainland. Thirty-four years of it.

wishes.name: Musa Abubakar
wishes.message: Oga Segun, you paid for our exams out of your own pocket and told us to pass it on. We are passing it on.

title: Baby Zara's naming
pull_quote: Everyone who could not travel to Awka for the naming still got to say her name out loud on the page. We read the whole thing to her on her first birthday.

wishes.name: Beatrice Nnaji
wishes.message: Zara Adaeze. Two names, one from each side, and she will carry both proudly. Welcome, nwa m.

wishes.name: Ikenna Nnaji
wishes.message: She has her mother's forehead and her father's appetite. God help this family.

wishes.name: Uchenna Mmuo
wishes.message: Started a small savings for her here. By the time she can read this she will have forgotten we exist, but we will remember.

wishes.name: Ngozi Ilo
wishes.message: Seven years of waiting. Ifeoma, God kept His word.

wishes.name: Chinaza Nnaji
wishes.message: Zara, whenever you find this page: your entrance was very loud and everyone cried. Standard family behaviour.

title: David's housewarming
pull_quote: First house at thirty-four, after eight years of rent in other people's buildings. I wanted the people who watched me struggle to sign something permanent.

wishes.name: Seyi Adeniyi
wishes.message: From that one-room in Yaba with the leaking ceiling to this. I was there for the leaking ceiling, so I get to be loud today.

wishes.name: Gbenga Sowemimo
wishes.message: Congratulations. We have contributed towards a fridge so you can finally stop keeping meat at the neighbour's.

wishes.name: Iyabo Adekunle
wishes.message: My son. Your own roof. I did not sleep the night you sent me the pictures.

wishes.name: Bolanle Ilesanmi
wishes.message: Housewarming means we are coming every Sunday now. This is legally binding.

wishes.name: Musa Sadiq
wishes.message: Eight years of saving while everyone around you was flexing. This is what discipline buys.

title: Zainab & Abdul
pull_quote: Our aunties in Kaduna do not use apps. They sent their prayers through their grandchildren and every single one is on the page.

wishes.name: Ibrahim Musa
wishes.message: My daughter. Abdul, she is the best thing this house has produced. Take care of her.

wishes.name: Fatima Sani
wishes.message: Barka da aure! From Zaria hostel gist to a whole nikkah. May Allah bless your union.

wishes.name: Maryam Garba
wishes.message: Zainab, you organised every single one of our study groups. Now go and organise a whole marriage.

wishes.name: Aisha Lawal
wishes.message: I carried you as a baby in Kano. Today I am watching from Jeddah. Allah ya albarkace ku.

wishes.name: Yusuf Aliyu
wishes.message: Brother, you talked yourself into this one. May your patience be as long as your talking.

title: Dr Temitope
pull_quote: Seven years, two strikes and one funding gap. The page was the first time I let people see how hard it had actually been.

wishes.name: Adebayo Oguntola
wishes.message: You rewrote chapter four eleven times without ever once complaining to me. That is the whole doctorate, right there.

wishes.name: Kemi Balogun
wishes.message: My sister the doctor. Not the useful kind, she is quick to say, but still.

wishes.name: Tosin Adewale
wishes.message: Who is going to fix the centrifuge now? Congratulations Dr Balogun, and please answer your phone.

wishes.name: Abiola Balogun
wishes.message: Seven years. Every time you said you would quit, you did not. That is my child.

wishes.name: Opeyemi Aluko
wishes.message: You taught my daughter maths for free for two years while doing this. Congratulations does not cover it.

title: Kelechi at 21
pull_quote: My friends are broke students so nobody was sending money. They sent voice notes instead and honestly those were better.

wishes.name: Uzoma Anyanwu
wishes.message: Twenty-one. Legally a man, still cannot boil rice. Proud of you anyway, small.

wishes.name: Chinwe Anyanwu
wishes.message: You have been singing since you were four and driving all of us mad. Now people pay for it. Happy birthday.

wishes.name: Somto Ude
wishes.message: Happy birthday to the worst striker in Enugu but the best person to have around after a loss.

wishes.name: Ifeyinwa Anyanwu
wishes.message: Twenty-one years ago I was seventeen and terrified. You made me brave. Happy birthday my son.

wishes.name: Nnenna Okeke
wishes.message: Everyone here is being sentimental so I will just say: you still owe me ₦2,000 from January.

title: Aisha at 35
pull_quote: I run a small tailoring school for girls here. On my birthday my old students found the page and wrote about lessons I had completely forgotten teaching.

registry.name: Two more sewing machines for the school

wishes.name: Rukayya Aliyu
wishes.message: You taught me to sew when I had left school and thought that was the end. I now employ four girls. Happy birthday Aunty Aisha.

wishes.name: Zahra Bello
wishes.message: Thirty-five and still the strictest teacher in Sokoto. We have contributed towards the new machines.

wishes.name: Ibrahim Sani
wishes.message: My wife, you turned a room in our house into a school. Barka da ranar haihuwa.

wishes.name: Hadiza Usman
wishes.message: You gave me fabric on credit for two years and never once asked for it back. I am paying it forward now.

wishes.name: Umar Sani
wishes.message: Big sister, from the girl who sold pure water after school. Look what you built.

title: Bukola & Dare
pull_quote: Two hundred people at the engagement and another four hundred on the page. My grandmother dictated hers to my cousin and it is the one I reread.

wishes.name: Alice Fashola
wishes.message: Omo mi, may your home be sweet. May you two grow old and still be arguing about small things.

wishes.name: Morenike Sotayo
wishes.message: Bukola we have been planning this since secondary school when you drew the dress in your notebook. It looked exactly like that.

wishes.name: Wale Ogunleye
wishes.message: Dare, my guy. You met her at a bus stop in 2018 and refused to give up. Persistence pays.

wishes.name: Modupe Onabanjo
wishes.message: The dancing! I have not seen your father move like that since 1994.

wishes.name: Tunji Ajibade
wishes.message: Watching from Atlanta. We could not travel but we did not miss a thing. Congratulations to both families.

title: Nnamdi's thanksgiving
pull_quote: After the surgery my family made a page instead of a WhatsApp broadcast. It stopped me having to tell the same story ninety times, and people gave towards the hospital bill without anyone having to ask.

wishes.name: Chidera Okoro
wishes.message: Eleven hours in that waiting room. Daddy, you came back to us. That is the whole prayer answered.

wishes.name: Chukwuma Iheanacho
wishes.message: Class captain 1991, still refusing to slow down. Take the rest seriously this time, Nnamdi.

wishes.name: Emeka Ezenwa
wishes.message: As your surgeon I should stay professional, but I have never seen a patient argue that hard for a discharge. Rest.

wishes.name: Cecilia Obiora
wishes.message: The whole church held you up for three weeks. Welcome back to the front pew.

wishes.name: Adaugo Okoro
wishes.message: Uncle, my children asked every single night. Tonight I told them you were home.

title: Ronke opens the shop
pull_quote: A bookshop in Ibadan in this economy. My friends thought I had lost my mind, then quietly funded half the opening stock.

wishes.name: Yinka Oshodi
wishes.message: Eleven years of you recommending books nobody asked about. Now you get paid for it. We are so happy for you.

wishes.name: Dele Salami
wishes.message: My sister quit a bank job to sell books. Bravest person I know, and I say that with love and mild panic.

wishes.name: Toyin Salami
wishes.message: Your mother read to you every night on that mat. She would have queued at the door this morning.

wishes.name: Wasiu Adigun
wishes.message: Ibadan needs this. Reserve me a corner and a stool and I will be there every Saturday.

wishes.name: Simisola Ajayi
wishes.message: I am nine and Aunty Ronke gave me my first book. Congratulations on your shop.

title: Wanjiru at 30
pull_quote: Everyone in Nairobi sends money by phone anyway. The difference was that here the money came with something written next to it.

wishes.name: Njeri Mwangi
wishes.message: Thirty and about to climb a mountain. You have been like this since campus and we love you for it.

wishes.name: Kevin Otieno
wishes.message: Happy birthday to the person who always books the Uber and never asks anyone to split it.

wishes.name: Grace Kamau
wishes.message: My firstborn. You were three weeks late arriving and you have been on your own schedule ever since.

wishes.name: Brian Ochieng
wishes.message: From Kisumu to Nairobi to running your own studio. Heri ya kuzaliwa, dada.

wishes.name: Wambui Kariuki
wishes.message: Thirty years old and still calls her aunt every Sunday. That is how she was raised.

title: Kwame graduates
pull_quote: My father passed in my second year. On graduation day his old colleagues found the page and wrote to me about him. I was not expecting that at all.

wishes.name: Akosua Mensah
wishes.message: Kwame, your mother sold kenkey through every one of those four years. Today belongs to both of you.

wishes.name: Yaw Boateng
wishes.message: We worked with your father at the ministry for nineteen years. He talked about you constantly. He would be unbearable today.

wishes.name: Kojo Mensah
wishes.message: Big brother! First graduate in the house. I have three years to catch up, so no pressure on me at all.

wishes.name: Ama Owusu
wishes.message: You explained econometrics to me in the canteen for two whole semesters. Congratulations, and thank you.

wishes.name: Abena Mensah
wishes.message: Every 4am at the market was for this morning. Ayekoo, my son.

title: Thandiwe & Sipho
pull_quote: We asked for contributions to the house deposit instead of gifts. Nobody was offended, and we are now eleven months ahead on the bond.

wishes.name: Nomsa Ndlovu
wishes.message: Sipho, you brought this girl home three years ago and I told you then not to lose her. You listened for once.

wishes.name: Lerato Molefe
wishes.message: Thandi, you have been planning this in a notebook since res. Every detail was exactly as you drew it.

wishes.name: Bongani Khumalo
wishes.message: Two families, one very long lobola negotiation, one excellent day. Congratulations to you both.

wishes.name: Vusi Dlamini
wishes.message: Watching from Durban with a plate on my lap. Beautiful ceremony. Beautiful people.

wishes.name: Naledi Mokoena
wishes.message: Maid of honour speech was too long, I know. But I have known her since Grade 4, so.

title: Baby Amani
pull_quote: My sisters are in Arusha, Doha and Toronto. The shower happened in three time zones at once and nobody felt left out.

wishes.name: Zawadi Juma
wishes.message: Little sister, you are going to be a wonderful mother. I have watched you practise on all of our children for years.

wishes.name: Rehema Juma
wishes.message: We cannot be there but we have sent everything except ourselves. Karibu mtoto.

wishes.name: Baraka Mwakalinga
wishes.message: Neema, you have carried this pregnancy while finishing your degree. Extraordinary.

wishes.name: Asha Juma
wishes.message: My grandchild. I have waited long enough to say those two words.

wishes.name: Grace Kimaro
wishes.message: Sleep is a myth, water is your friend, and everyone else's advice is optional — including mine.

title: Papa Uwase
pull_quote: My father kept every letter anyone ever wrote him. It felt right that the last thing about him would be a page full of letters too.

registry.name: Bursary for two students a year

wishes.name: Aline Uwase
wishes.message: Papa, you walked me to school every morning for eleven years and used the time to teach me French. I still count in French when I am tired.

wishes.name: Eric Habimana
wishes.message: Mwalimu, you told us that a country is rebuilt one classroom at a time. Many of us are teachers now because of that sentence.

wishes.name: Jean-Paul Ntaganda
wishes.message: My brother. Fifty years of friendship, and not one cross word between us. Thank you for all of it.

wishes.name: Claudine Mukamana
wishes.message: He fixed my roof in 2009 and refused to let me thank him publicly. So I am doing it now, publicly.

wishes.name: Olivier Rwema
wishes.message: Bass section, forty-one years, never once late. Rest well, Emmanuel.

title: Fatou at 60
pull_quote: My daughters built it in Paris and I only found out on the morning. Sixty years old and I have never been so surprised in my life.

wishes.name: Aminata Diop
wishes.message: Maman, you sent both of us to university on what you made from that stall. Sixty years and you have not rested once.

wishes.name: Awa Sow
wishes.message: Tante Fatou, forty years in the same corner and you have never short-changed a single customer. Bonne fête.

wishes.name: Ousmane Diop
wishes.message: My big sister. You raised me after Papa died and you were only nineteen. Everything I have started with you.

wishes.name: Mariama Ndiaye
wishes.message: You fed my children for a whole month in 2011 and told nobody. I never forgot, and now everybody knows.

wishes.name: Coumba Fall
wishes.message: Sixty years of faith and hard work. May Allah grant you rest and many more.

title: Yosef retires
pull_quote: Forty-one years driving the same route. The passengers made the page, not the family. I did not know they knew my name.

registry.name: The coffee shop he always talked about

wishes.name: Abebe Girma
wishes.message: Forty-one years and you waited for me every single time I was running down the hill. Thank you, Ato Yosef.

wishes.name: Selam Tesfaye
wishes.message: Abaye, you drove all night so we could eat. Now you sit down and we bring you the coffee.

wishes.name: Tadesse Bekele
wishes.message: Not one accident in four decades. The younger drivers should be taking notes, and they know it.

wishes.name: Hanna Gebre
wishes.message: You let me ride free for a whole month when I lost my job in 2016. I have never told anyone until today.

wishes.name: Dawit Alemu
wishes.message: My children called your bus 'Yosef's bus'. It will be strange to see anyone else in that seat.

title: Mum's 60th
pull_quote: Mum has cancelled the same holiday four times in twenty years. Her friends and her old ward put in together, and this time it was booked before she could argue.

registry.name: The Italy trip she keeps cancelling

wishes.name: Sarah Kelly
wishes.message: Mum, you have talked about Lake Como since 1998 and cancelled it four times. It is booked. You are going.

wishes.name: Angela Hartley
wishes.message: Sixty years young and still setting a pace none of us can hold on the Edale hills. Happy birthday Maggie.

wishes.name: Dave Whittaker
wishes.message: Neighbours for twenty-six years. Not one cross word, one shared hedge, a thousand cups of tea.

wishes.name: Marie Sullivan
wishes.message: Thirty-two years of night shifts on this ward. The place is not the same when you are off, Mags.

wishes.name: Callum Kelly
wishes.message: Nan, thank you for picking me up from school every day for six years and never telling Mum about the sweets.

title: Marco at 40
pull_quote: Half my friends are scattered across Europe now. One link meant they all turned up in the same place for once, even if it was only a webpage.

wishes.name: Giulia Rossi
wishes.message: Forty! And still the only person in this family who can cook properly. Buon compleanno, fratellone.

wishes.name: Matteo Conti
wishes.message: Twelve years of Thursday dinners. You have never once let anyone else pay first. Tonight we did.

wishes.name: Luca Ferrari
wishes.message: From two guys sharing a flat with no heating in Bologna to this. Auguri, my friend.

wishes.name: Anna Rossi
wishes.message: Quarant'anni. I still see the boy who would not eat vegetables. Ti voglio bene.

wishes.name: Elena Bianchi
wishes.message: Happy birthday to the man who drove six hours to help me move a sofa and never mentioned it again.

title: Priya & Arjun
pull_quote: Our families are in Toronto, Mumbai and Nairobi. The page was the only place all three sets of relatives were ever in the same room.

wishes.name: Rakesh Sharma
wishes.message: Arjun, we have watched you look after her for six years. There was never really a question.

wishes.name: Anita Shah
wishes.message: Priya! We have been asking since 2021 and were told to mind our business. We were right to ask.

wishes.name: Meera Joshi
wishes.message: You met in a queue for bad coffee on campus. Best queue in history.

wishes.name: Sushila Sharma
wishes.message: I am eighty-three and my granddaughter is engaged. Someone please explain this page to me again.

wishes.name: Daniel Foster
wishes.message: Congratulations from the neighbours who hear all your kitchen arguments through the wall. You two are great.

title: Daniel graduates
pull_quote: First person in my family to finish college. My grandmother does not use the internet, so my cousin read her every message down the phone.

wishes.name: Ruth Mercer
wishes.message: Danny, your granddad cleaned floors at that same university for nineteen years. Today you walked across its stage.

wishes.name: Alicia Vargas
wishes.message: Four years of closing shifts and 6am classes. We watched you do it. Go get them, kid.

wishes.name: Hector Ramirez
wishes.message: You were never the fastest on the team but you never missed a single practice. That is what got you here.

wishes.name: Denise Mercer
wishes.message: Two jobs, one car, one very stubborn son. Worth every mile of it.

wishes.name: Katie Mercer
wishes.message: My big brother, the college graduate. I am telling everyone at school. Everyone.

title: Baby Lin
pull_quote: Everyone wanted to buy the same three things. Putting one list on one page meant we ended up with a cot instead of nine sets of muslin cloths.

wishes.name: Wei Ling Tan
wishes.message: Mei, you have been the person everyone else leans on for years. Now it is your turn to be looked after.

wishes.name: Priscilla Ong
wishes.message: Maternity leave starts Friday and we are already dreading it. Congratulations from all of us.

wishes.name: Soo Hoon Chen
wishes.message: Confinement food is coming whether you want it or not. That is not a negotiation.

wishes.name: Ben Lim
wishes.message: To my wife, who has done all of the hard part so far and still asks how my day was. I love you.

wishes.name: Jia Hui Goh
wishes.message: We were 15 when you said you'd be a scientist and a mum. Both, then. Of course both.

title: Fifty years of the Fernández
pull_quote: My parents have eleven grandchildren across four countries. Every one of them recorded something. My mother has watched them all at least twenty times.

wishes.name: Lucía Fernández
wishes.message: Fifty years, four children, eleven grandchildren, one very small kitchen table that somehow fitted all of us.

wishes.name: Marta Fernández
wishes.message: Abuelo, abuela — between us we are in Madrid, Berlin, Buenos Aires and Cork, and all of us learned to cook from you.

wishes.name: Rosa Delgado
wishes.message: Fifty years in the same building. Nobody has ever heard them shout. Felicidades a los dos.

wishes.name: Antonio Ruiz
wishes.message: I married them in 1975 as a young priest. I am old now. They are not, apparently.

wishes.name: Miguel Fernández
wishes.message: Papá still opens the car door for her. Fifty years later. That is the whole lesson.

title: For Dad
pull_quote: We put it up the day after the funeral, when everyone had gone home and the house was too quiet. People are still adding to it a year later.

wishes.name: James O'Connor
wishes.message: Da, you drove me to training four nights a week for eleven years and stood in the rain for every minute of it.

wishes.name: Declan Byrne
wishes.message: Michael ran the under-12s for two decades and never let a child sit out a match for not having boots. He bought the boots.

wishes.name: Tom Gallagher
wishes.message: Same seat, same pint, same terrible jokes, thirty-odd years. The corner is very quiet now.

wishes.name: Aoife O'Connor
wishes.message: Grandad, I am learning your song on the guitar. I will get it eventually.

wishes.name: Bernadette O'Connor
wishes.message: Forty-three years married to that man. I would do the whole thing again tomorrow, arguments included.

title: Amara's first exhibition
pull_quote: I could not afford to frame the work. I put the page up asking for help with framing and it was covered in a day and a half.

wishes.name: Chuka Ibe
wishes.message: You painted in a corridor for three years because you could not afford a studio. Now the whole wall is yours.

wishes.name: Josephine Nwankwo
wishes.message: I told you art would not feed you. I have never been happier to be wrong. Congratulations, my daughter.

wishes.name: Tobi Ayodele
wishes.message: Bought piece number four before the doors even opened. Framing it in my living room where everyone has to see it.

wishes.name: Benjamin Nwankwo
wishes.message: Your grandfather carved masks in Awka for sixty years. It has just skipped a generation, that is all.

wishes.name: Zainab Okonjo
wishes.message: I have watched you doubt every single one of these paintings. Look at the room. Look at the faces.
